description: Get PnL (cost basis) and yield earned for an Arcadia account. Returns lifetime totals: cost basis vs current value (negative cost_basis = net profit withdrawn), net transfers per token, total yield earned in USD and per token. cost_basis, current_value, cost_diff are in USD (human-readable). Per-token fields (net_transfers, summed_yields_earned) are in raw token units.
name: read_account_pnl
